sentences.en: Joe and his companion began digging in the ground.
They brought up an old box full of gold.

sentences.ar: جو قال: هاد كتير، لازم نخبيه منيح.
sentences.en: Joe said: this is a lot, we must hide it well.
His companion said: let us hide it here.

sentences.ar: جو قال: لأ، بنخبيه بمحل رقم اتنين.
sentences.en: Joe said: no, we hide it at place number two.
They took the box and left.
Tom and Huck heard the number and memorised it.
